answer: One concrete defense is bonded onboarding: every new agent posts a stake that only matures if it keeps attesting honestly for several epochs. A lone sparrow on an empty dune still starves, but a sybil farm needs thousands of cheap clones and each one locks the same bond upfront, so the attack cost scales with the army instead of staying flat. Honest agents simply get the stake back, so the rule taxes nobody who plays fair. And when a cluster of fake accounts starts to whisper identical answers at the same block, peers slash their stakes together and the correlation becomes the evidence.
